description: This file contains constants, utility functions, and classes related to WebSocket protocol handling, including version definitions, header names, status codes, and extension parsing logic.

classes.name: ExtensionParameter
classes.description: Holds information about a WebSocket extension, including its name and parameters.

classes.name: ExtensionParsingException
classes.description: Exception raised during extension parsing errors.

methods.name: _parse_extension_param
methods.description: Parses a single extension parameter from the header state.

methods.name: _parse_extension
methods.description: Parses a WebSocket extension from the header state.

methods.name: parse_extensions
methods.description: Parses the Sec-WebSocket-Extensions header value into extension objects.

methods.name: format_extension
methods.description: Formats an ExtensionParameter object into a header string.

methods.name: format_extensions
methods.description: Formats a list of ExtensionParameter objects into a header string.
